content.text:
The `redis-data/` directory contains transient database files managed by Redis, often with restricted permissions, and should not be included in version control.

I have added `redis-data/` to your `.gitignore` file. Subsequent `git add` commands will now correctly ignore this directory, resolving the permission error.
